composition: ONE fixed camera for the whole series: about 35 degrees above the table, slightly from the front, dish centered, the dish and food filling about 75% of the square with even margins (at least 12% on every side). Matte clay / miniature toy texture, rounded simplified shapes, appetizing colors that are bright but not neon.

table, cloth, background, backdrop or drop shadow outside the dish
